name: forge-build-intel-swarm
purpose: Collect, in parallel and read-only, every fact needed to turn the Forge blueprint (hybrid A+B design) into a phase/wave/task build plan.

decision.title: Hybrid design: A (Command) shell + B (Bento) Today home
definition: Shell = A: bottom tabs (<600px) -> 72px icon rail (600-1023) -> labelled sidebar (>=1024), driven by CSS container queries on the app root, not device names.
Navigation = one route per screen (e.g. /life/tasks), a command palette (Cmd/Ctrl+K), shortcuts (Cmd+1..6, N new, X complete).
Domain screens (Life, Logic, Money, Invest, Agents and their 17 sub-views) = A: dense list/blocks with a right-hand focus inspector from >=1024px.

Today = B: a NEW first tab, a bento tile grid re-flowing 2 -> 4 -> 6 columns (streak, wallet, pets, code ring, tasks, spend donut, mood, tutor prompt, watch tile) with level + wallet pills in the header. B's floating dock is dropped; A's rail/sidebar/tabs replace it.
Theme = existing 6 data-accent themes stay; B's warm cream palette becomes a 7th theme; Today tiles use pastel tokens defined for both dark and light themes.
Open (decide in the plan, flag if research disagrees): whether Habits/Growth sub-views also use B tiles; how Level/XP is derived from existing streaks.

repoFacts: React 18 + Vite 5 SPA, tabs are component state in src/App.jsx (no router). Tabs: Life, LogicBuilding, Expenses (Money), Invest, Agents; all lazy-loaded.
Local-first store: src/store.js wraps localforage/IndexedDB; src/sync/{logic,engine}.js reconciles each key against Supabase table kv_store with last-write-wins per whole key, 700ms debounce.
Serverless /api/*.js (Vercel style) also mounted into the Vite dev server by a plugin in vite.config.js. /api/agent is owner-gated and proxies Groq.

Tests: node --test "test/*.test.js". No CI, no linter, no router, no service worker, no vercel.json. node_modules may be absent on a fresh checkout: run npm ci first (the baseline is 97 passing tests, build OK).
public/dsa/mastery-map.html is a separate 8,320-line standalone page synced through the same Supabase session.

taskFields.title: imperative, one deliverable
taskFields.size: S (<half day) | M (about a day) | L (multi-day; split if you can)
taskFields.phaseHint: P0 shell+design system | P1 PWA | P2 sync v2 | P3 native shell | P4 quality+ops | P5 AI
taskFields.writes: exact paths or dir globs the task will create/modify; be precise, parallel safety depends on it
taskFields.reads: paths the task needs as input (optional)
taskFields.deps: ids of other proposals (any agent) that must finish first, [] if none
taskFields.acceptance: a command to run or an observable behaviour that proves it is done

agents.name: Shell and CSS
agents.charter: Inventory everything in the current shell and stylesheet that the responsive hybrid shell must change, and design the insertion points.
blueprintFocus: Ask 3 shell CSS in the design styles (.dA, .dB)
questions: List every layout-affecting rule with file:line: max-width, position fixed/sticky, bottom offsets that assume the tab-bar height, 100dvh, safe-area insets, z-index stack. Which break when nav moves to a rail or sidebar?
Which class names used by tab components assume single-column phone width? Grep src/tabs for them.
List all :hover rules (to wrap in (hover:hover)) and interactive elements with no focus style.
Map the 6 existing data-accent themes to tokens; list the new tokens the hybrid needs (cream theme, pastel tile colours for dark+light, inspector surface, rail/sidebar widths).
Where do Sheet, Toast and the expense FAB position themselves, and what changes at each breakpoint?
Router: App.jsx keeps tabs in state. Compare react-router vs a ~30-line hash/history router for this app (bundle cost, deep links, Capacitor file/WKWebView compatibility). Recommend one.
Today tab: what is the minimal App.jsx change to add it as the first tab and make it the default (currently Life)?
Propose the task breakdown for the shell (tokens, grid shell, nav rail/sidebar/tabs, router, command palette, inspector pane, focus/hover hygiene) with exact write-sets.

agents.name: Life tab
agents.charter: Understand Life (tasks, reminders, notes, habits, growth) well enough to split it into hybrid screens and to feed Today tiles.
blueprintFocus: Ask 3 hybrid screens for life.* in PLAN/BLK data
questions: Map the components inside Life.jsx (1078 lines) with line ranges and which store keys each reads/writes. Propose a split into files with write-sets so several people/agents can work in parallel.
Is Notes.jsx still used, or is notes now inside Life? State exactly how notes are reached.
For each of the 5 sub-views, what is the natural list/detail split for master/detail + inspector at >=1024px, and what does the phone do instead?
Which exports of src/life/logic.js (petState, earnings, streaks, quick-add parsing) give Today tiles their data? Does anything like Level/XP exist? If not, propose a derivation from existing data.
How does drag-and-drop (src/dnd) behave with touch, mouse and Pencil today, and what breaks in a multi-pane layout?
What tests protect Life, and what new pure-logic functions would the hybrid need that should be unit tested?
Propose the Life task breakdown with exact write-sets.

agents.name: Logic tab and DSA map
agents.charter: Understand Logic (code, puzzles, exams, DSA map) and how the standalone DSA page can live inside the new shell.
readScope: public/dsa/mastery-map.html (head, persistence script, layout CSS only; do not read all 8,320 lines)
questions: Note the naming trap: src/tabs/Today.jsx is the Codeforces view, not the new Today home. List every import/reference so renaming is safe.
What data feeds the Code ring tile on Today (solved today etc.) and how is it computed?

DSA mastery map: what localStorage keys and Supabase calls does it use, how responsive is it, and compare embedding options (iframe route vs port to React vs keep standalone link) with a recommendation, incl. sync/auth/session implications and service-worker scope.
Failure modes of /api/cf and /api/puzzle (CORS, rate limits, empty handle) that the new layout must still surface.
Sub-view master/detail opportunities for Code, Puzzles, Exams; what is phone-only vs wide.
Propose the Logic task breakdown with exact write-sets.

agents.name: Money and Invest
agents.charter: Understand Money (spend, budgets, goals, loans) and Invest (learn, research, watchlist) and plan how to split and re-layout the two largest files.
blueprintFocus: Ask 3 money.* and invest.* blocks (spend donut, watch tiles)
questions: Map components and line ranges in Expenses.jsx (1353 lines) and Invest.jsx (786 lines) and propose splits with write-sets for parallel work.
Which store keys does each sub-view read/write? Which are arrays of records with ids (relevant to sync v2) vs maps?
What data does Today need from here (month spend vs budget, watchlist movers) and which existing functions already compute it?
Do any charts exist today (which lib or hand-rolled SVG)? What would the donut/sparkline need?
Which parts assume narrow width, fixed bottom FAB or full-screen sheets?
Propose the Money and Invest task breakdowns with exact write-sets.

agents.name: API, agents and security
agents.charter: Audit the serverless layer and the Agents tab for what the app/native/streaming work will need.
blueprintFocus: learning graph nodes: auth, rls, csp, ratelimit, llmgw, sse, proxy, serverless
questions: Grep every fetch('/api...') call site in src. A Capacitor WKWebView origin is capacitor://localhost, so relative /api calls will break: list what needs an API base URL config and CORS headers.
Document the /api/agent auth flow (owner gating), env vars, error leakage fixes, and any missing rate limiting or input size limits.

Can Vercel functions as written stream SSE for agent replies? What must change in api/agent.js and Agents.jsx? Which model/env defaults exist (code says openai/gpt-oss-120b, README says llama-3.3-70b)? Flag the mismatch.
There is no vercel.json: what runtime defaults apply (Node version, function timeout, region, caching headers for /api/puzzle)?
Security checklist for shipping a native bundle: where could secrets leak, what CSP is feasible given inline styles/scripts and the Supabase websocket, what headers are missing.
Propose API/security task breakdown with exact write-sets, tagged by phase hint.

agents.name: Data and sync
agents.charter: Design the sync v2 migration precisely from the real code: every synced key, every consumer, the schema, and the safest rollout.
blueprintFocus: learning graph nodes: lww, lamport, tomb, outbox, rt, pgmodel, rls, backup, optim
questions: List every key in SYNCED_KEYS with its value shape (infer from callers) and every consumer file:line. Classify: array of id'd records (row-able), map keyed by id/date, single object, scalar.

Propose a concrete table design per key family (not one table per key if a generic records table is better); give exact SQL incl. RLS policies, indexes, rev/delta-pull, tombstones, realtime filter. Justify generic-vs-per-entity.

Design the client: a useSynced(key) hook compatible with existing getX/saveX/mutateX call sites, hybrid logical clock, per-record merge, outbox with retry/backoff + idempotent client ids, tombstone GC.
Migration plan from kv_store: dual-write, backfill, feature flag per key, verification query, rollback, and what to keep as backup. How does it coexist with __pre_sync_backup and claimOwner?
Interplay with undo.js, mutate queues, useHydrate races (see git log) and App.jsx KEY_TO_TAB remounting.

Propose the testing plan (pure logic tests, engine tests with fakes, a two-device simulation) and the task breakdown with exact write-sets. Flag which tasks need Supabase dashboard actions only the user can do.

agents.name: Build, test, PWA and CI infrastructure
agents.charter: Establish the real baseline and the tooling decisions for PWA, E2E device matrix and CI.
blueprintFocus: learning graph nodes: manifest, sw, cachestrat, perf, testpyr, e2e, ci, obs, flags
questions: Run the baseline and report exact results: npm ci, npm test, npm run build (bundle sizes per chunk). Report anything failing or flaky. Do not modify tracked files.

PWA: verify with npm view which vite-plugin-pwa version supports Vite 5, and whether workbox-window is needed. Recommend generateSW vs injectManifest for this app (offline shell, SWR assets, never cache authenticated /api or Supabase calls). Include update-prompt UX.
Icons: the manifest uses an inline emoji data-URI. List the exact icon set needed (192/512, maskable, apple-touch 180) and how to generate it reproducibly.

E2E: Chromium + Playwright are preinstalled in this environment; propose a playwright.config with the 5 device projects from the blueprint matrix, how to run against vite preview, and how to stub Supabase/auth so tests are hermetic.
CI: no CI exists. Propose a GitHub Actions workflow (install cache, test, build, e2e, bundle-size check) and Vercel preview setup; list what the user must configure.
Lint/format/typecheck: none exist; recommend the minimum worth adding (and what not to add).
Propose the infrastructure task breakdown with exact write-sets; remember package.json and package-lock.json are single-writer hot spots.

agents.name: Blueprint requirements and learning track
agents.charter: Re-read the whole blueprint and consolidate it into a numbered requirements list, a contradiction list, and a concept-to-phase learning track.
readScope: docs/forge-blueprint.html (for the RAW concept table and any data the text omits)
questions: Produce REQ-01.. requirements (functional and non-functional), each with a blueprint section reference, a priority (must/should/could) and the phase it belongs to. Apply the hybrid decision: where the blueprint says design A, B or C, resolve it to the hybrid.

List contradictions and gaps inside the blueprint itself (known: nav '5 tabs' vs a 6th Today tab; sidebar 220px in the CSS snippet vs 216px in the design mock; blueprint calls delivery steps Phase 1/3 in 2.1 but P0-P5 in 2.7; Capacitor origin vs relative /api; hover guard for A/B components). Find more.

Extract the RAW learning-graph table from the HTML and output docs/plan/research/B1-concept-phase-map.json: [{id,label,category,phase,level,requires:[...]}]. Then summarise per phase which concepts must be learned BEFORE that phase starts (prerequisites not taught by an earlier phase), as a short table.
Define 'done' for the whole project as a checklist a reviewer could run on a deployed build (responsive matrix, offline, install, sync two devices, native app).
Propose any process/documentation tasks (ADRs, README updates) with exact write-sets.

agents.name: Hybrid design specification
agents.charter: Turn the blueprint's A and B prototypes into one implementable spec for the hybrid and a component inventory mapped to the real codebase.
readScope: docs/forge-blueprint.html (the <style> blocks for .dsn/.dA/.dB and the script section 'SECTION 4' only: DESIGNS, BLK, HOME, PLAN, DT data)
src/tabs/*.jsx (grep only, to find existing equivalents)
questions: Write the token table: A tokens, B tokens, and the reconciled hybrid token set (names, dark and light values, how the cream theme sits next to the existing 6 themes). Check contrast for text on the pastel tiles in both themes.
Specify the shell per breakpoint (<600, 600-1023, 1024-1279, >=1280): nav pattern, widths, panes, FAB, header, ⌘K palette contents, shortcuts. Resolve 216 vs 220px.

Specify Today (B tiles): each tile with its width class per breakpoint (2/4/6 col spans), content, and the exact store key / function that provides each datum in the real app, and what is missing (Level/XP, mood log shape, streak source).

For each of the 17 sub-views: the blocks, which are A-style list/inspector vs B-style tiles (default: A everywhere except Today; recommend whether Habits/Growth should use tiles), inspector content, phone behaviour.

Component inventory (Row, Chip, Bar, Ring, Donut, Spark, Tile, Rail, Sidebar, Tabs, Palette, Inspector, Sheet, Toast, EmptyState...): props, which existing CSS/JSX is reusable (grep src), what is new, and where it should live in the file tree (e.g. src/ui/*).
Interaction + accessibility spec: focus order, keyboard map, hover-only affordances to avoid, 44px targets, reduced motion, touch vs pointer.
Propose the design-system and screen-level task breakdown with exact write-sets, ordered so primitives come before screens.

agents.name: External facts and library choices
agents.charter: Verify, with sources, the external claims the plan rests on and pick libraries/versions. Use WebSearch/WebFetch (standard mode first) and npm view; mark anything you could not verify.
questions: Capacitor: current major version, minimum iOS/Xcode, how to host a Vite build, the capacitor://localhost origin and its effect on Supabase auth persistence and fetch/CORS, recommended plugins for push, haptics, secure storage, keyboard, status bar.
iOS PWA: Web Push requirements (iOS 16.4+, installed only), Background Sync availability, storage eviction rules for Safari tabs vs Home Screen apps, navigator.storage.persist support.

CSS: minimum Safari/Chrome versions for container queries, :has, dvh, color-mix (all used by the blueprint). Compare with the project's actual browser targets (iOS version of the user's devices is unknown: list as a question).

Supabase: free-tier project pause policy and limits relevant here (realtime messages, db size), realtime postgres_changes filter limitations for per-record tables, hybrid logical clock/delta-pull patterns that fit.
Router and PWA libraries: current versions and bundle sizes (npm view / bundlephobia-style numbers if reachable) for react-router, vite-plugin-pwa, workbox-window, @capacitor/*.
Apple Developer Program fee, TestFlight limits, review constraints for a personal app wrapping a web app (guideline 4.2 minimum functionality).
For every claim give: claim, source URL, date, confidence (high/med/low). Output library decision tasks.
